title: Mera Hussain Mera Hussain
body:
Ya Hussain Ya Hussain (×5)
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Maqtal mey deti hai ek maa duhaii,
Lut thi hai haye meri kamayi,
Koyi bacha ley Mera Hussain Mera Hussain
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Ghazi nahi hai Akbar nahi hai,
Hadh hai k nanha Asgar nahi hai,
Ab rehgaya hai tanha Hussain,
Mera Hussain....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Lashe pey Ghazi k boli tadap kar,
Zainab k bhai ko gherey hai lashkar,
Utho bulata hai beta Hussain.
Mera Hussain....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Haye aseeri ranj o muhaan hai,
Sar se qadam tak zakhmi badan hai,
Apne lahoo mey hai doba Hussain,
Mera Hussain....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Loo chalrahi hai saye mey lao,
Dariya se lakar pani pelao,
Kausar ka malik hai pyasa Hussain Mera Hussain...
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain(×3)
Marzi ye rab hai chup hogaya hai,
Warna ye ibne sher e khuda hai,
Chahe ulat dey ye Duniya Hussain.
Mera Hussain....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Maqtal mey roro ke kehti thi Zehra,
Aram karne do isko zara sa,
Kitni shabon ka hai jagah Hussain,
Mera Hussain....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Mushkil mey kitni hai sitbte payambar,
Na zeen par hai na hai ye hai zameen par,
Teroon pey kab se hai Tehra Hussain,
Mera Hussain.....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Aye meri Zainab Qymey mey jao,
Sar nange baithi hai bahar na aao,
Seh na sakega ye sadma Hussain,
Mera Hussain.....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Khanjar chala jab Ibne ALI par,
Kaisi qayamat thi bitne nabi par,
Kehti thi dukhiya bus Ya Hussain,
Mera Hussain....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
Pani takallum jab bhi piya hai,
Ehsaas us dum mujhko huwa hai,
Duniya se guzra hai Pyasa Hussain,
Mera Hussain.....
Mera Hussain Mera Hussain (×3)
